module.description: Implement a module for pulse detection. The 1-bit input signal data_in is a continuous input, which is triggered by clk. When "data_in" changes from 0 to 1 to 0(3 cycles), this is considered as a "pulse". The indicating signal data_out is 1 at the end cycle of the "pulse", and then returns to 0 until the corresponding pulse appears again. For example, if data_in is 01010(5 cycles), the data_out is 00101.

ports.output: Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.

parameter_description.parameter: Initial state. A state waiting for pulse 0.

logic_description.description: Notice that below descriptions are along with tags <logic />. With a <logic type="combinational_logic" />, must construct this logic as interal wire declaration. Or this <logic type="combinational_logic" /> can be declared as a `reg` but only be used in always(*) block. With a <logic type="sequential_logic" />, must construct this logic as `reg` declaration. Must update this logic, in an always block, based on other <logic type="sequential_logic" /> or <logic type="combinational_logic" /> states. With a <logic type="sequential_logic_operation" />, no declaration for this keyword. Just place this operation sequence in below mentioned description. With a <logic type="combinational_logic_operation" />, no declaration for this keyword. Just based on the keyword `assign` to construct description of this combinational logic operation.
logic_description.logic: In the reset condition (~rst_n), set the state register to the initial state and set the data_out output to 0, indicating no pulse. Otherwise, the indicating signal data_out is 1 if `pulse_level2` reaches `s2` and `data_in` is 0. Otherwise, returns to 0 until the corresponding pulse appears again.
If `rst_n` is inactive, `pulse_level1` is reset to 0. Otherwise, `pulse_level1` is set to `pulse_level2`.

In case `pulse_level1` is `s0`, if `data_in` is 0, `pulse_level2` is set to `s1`, else `pulse_level2` is set to `s0`. In case `pulse_level1` is `s1`, if `data_in` is 1, `pulse_level2` is set to `s2`, else `pulse_level2` is set to `s1`. In case `pulse_level1` is `s2`, if `data_in` is 0, `pulse_level2` is set to `s3`, else `pulse_level2` is set to `s0`. In case `pulse_level1` is `s3`, if `data_in` is 1, `pulse_level2` is set to `s2`, else `pulse_level2` is set to `s1`.

module.implementation: Declare the module pulse_detect with input and output ports as specified in the ports statement. Declare a register state `pulse_level1` to keep track of the current state of the pulse detection process `pulse_level2`.
